real_ledger_access: SQLite URI mode=ro; PRAGMA query_only; transaction snapshot
cost_kind: recorded sanitized provider usage and pinned list-price local estimate; not account deduction
prompt_helpers_source: isolated git archive of exact paid source_commit
interpretation: All old rows/schema/holds/halt/revocations are independently compared, not inferred from receipt flags.
Actual native chunks and post-ranking version pruning are provenance checks; they do not prove relevance or semantic support.
Typed pre-dispatch zeros need reconstructed overflow plus owned real-gateway attestation and absence of ledger/wire. Missing rows alone remain unknown.
Raw provider text is not retained. Raw hashes, byte counts and schema diagnostics are recorded gateway observations; raw schema compliance cannot be independently reparsed from hashes.

For compact successes the audit independently expands bounded selected indexes against the exact current request and verifies the canonical output hash. This is separate from raw-wire schema diagnostics.
Canonical-arm output_sha256 hashes raw provider text; compact-arm output_sha256 hashes locally expanded GroundedPlan JSON. They are never pooled as the same raw-format metric.
Fresh fallback, route completion, source support and human usefulness require separate semantic review. No model or RAG improvement is inferred here.
